reason: I only hire people another owner I know has used, and nobody I know has heard of a Kuwait outfit with no clients. Pay-on-approval is clever, but my time going back and forth on WhatsApp at midnight still costs me if it goes wrong.
objection: No reviews, no past work, no UK presence, and their own site and Instagram don't look established yet, so why would I trust them with my business's face online?
would_change_my_mind: A local owner I know in Manchester telling me they built theirs and it was good.
